thread:
maria: Quick idea — postmortem follow-ups keep slipping. I propose a short standard timeline template + a lightweight tracker that enforces owners and SLAs. Thoughts?
kevin: +1. Can we make the tracker a single GitHub issue per incident with labels and a checklist? That way product and infra can subscribe.
sasha: Agreed. Also want a recurring incident tags field so we can query patterns.
jon-ic: For incident commander rotation: propose 2-week IC windows, with a handoff thread template. Automation: on call rotation creates a CRON job to page the new IC and create the GH issue.
oncall-bot: Scheduled reminder set: "weekly follow-up audit" every Mon 10:00am UTC — first run 1898766000
ops-coordinator: One more constraint — remediation owners should have explicit 'remediation SLA' like 7d for P1 fixes, 30d for P2. We should track misses and escalate in weekly ops sync.
maria: Example timeline template (compact):
```
- Day 0: Incident declared, IC assigned
- Day 1: Initial postmortem draft + action items created in GH
- Day 3: Owner ack + target completion dates set
- Day 7: P1 remediation due / status update
- Day 30: P2 remediation due / final verification
- 90d: Recurrence review & "did it recur?" check
```
kevin: Nice. For tracker fields: incident, incident_ts, root_postmortem_link, actions[] (owner, due_date, sla, status), recurrence_tags, last_escalation
sasha: Suggest adding 'regression_monitor_query' field to tie evals/metrics to the action.
jon-ic: I'll prototype a GH issue template and a small automator that creates the issue + assigns owner based on label. Who volunteers to own the automator?
maria: @kevin can own automator prototype; @sasha can own recurrence tagging & queries; I'll drive the timeline template + rollout docs.
ops-coordinator: Can we have a simple metrics card in Console: "open remediation SLA misses" and "avg time to close postmortem actions"? Add this to Redwood Console backlog.
kevin: I'll open a GH epic today and link the prototype. Target: initial prototype in 2 weeks (1898776032). Owner: kevin. /cc @jon-ic
maria: Great — next steps: kevin creates epic, jon prototypes automation, sasha defines recurrence taxonomy, ops adds Console card. We'll review in the 2-week ops sync. :thumbsup:
